active_frame_breakdown.scope: visible_traces and paint_traces_and_axes are subsets of ui; tessellation is separate. CPU timings exclude OS/GPU.

cold_frame_breakdown.scope: visible_traces and paint_traces_and_axes are subsets of ui; tessellation is separate. CPU timings exclude OS/GPU.

idle_frame_breakdown.scope: visible_traces and paint_traces_and_axes are subsets of ui; tessellation is separate. CPU timings exclude OS/GPU.

memory.scope: Separate statistics-only pass without UI rendering; RSS sampled via ps with 50ms sleeps plus process-launch latency. Peak is sampled, not an OS high-water mark; allocator retention can keep RSS above logical raw bytes after release.

scope: Full egui CPU UI plus tessellation with hover/pan/zoom events; warmed draw caches; identical cursors and panel dimensions for idle/active frames, idle uses completed cached statistics; excludes native OS event delivery, GPU and presentation.
